title: Concept: Marketing consent flags in a response
description: A set of consent flags for marketing channels in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The flags record what the customer refused, and a leak plus a past consent gives a caller the exact list of channels the customer opted out of, which is useful for a targeted pitch.
applicability: Deployments that render a set of consent flags for marketing channels into a customer- or partner-facing response.
